objectives: Describe the tasks of a clerk, a legal assistant, an assistant notary, a substitute and a notary.
List the legal requirements for an assistant notary, a substitute and a notary, with the article for each.
Explain how the competition for notaries and the exam for substitutes work.
Prepare an application for a first job in a notary office.

cards.front: How many assistant notaries may a notary appoint?
What are the requirements for an assistant notary?
cards.back: The requirements for a notary, **regardless of age and experience**: citizenship, law degree, legal capacity, clean criminal record and the others in Art. 8(1) ЗННД (Art. 41(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: What does an assistant notary add to the signature?
cards.back: "помощник" (Art. 40(2) ЗННД). A substitute adds "по заместване" (Art. 46(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: Who is liable for damage caused by the assistant notary?
cards.back: The notary, **jointly** with the assistant (Art. 40(3) ЗННД).

cards.front: What does a substitute assistant notary need?
cards.back: **Three years** of legal experience and an **exam** for the first term (Art. 46 ЗННД).

cards.front: Maximum term of a substitution by an assistant notary?
cards.back: **Two years** from the entry in the register (Art. 46(2) ЗННД).

cards.front: When is the exam for substitutes held, and what form does it have?
cards.back: Twice a year, in **April** and **October**. It is **oral**, with one theoretical and one practical ticket. Pass mark: good (4).

cards.front: Age limit for a new notary?
cards.back: **Up to 60 years** (Art. 8(1) ЗННД). Older persons may apply only when the term is extended for lack of candidates (Art. 11(5)).

cards.front: How many notary places does a district have?
cards.back: At least **two**; one place for every **10,000 inhabitants** (Art. 10(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: What are the parts of the competition for notaries?
cards.back: A **written** exam (3 hours, anonymous) and an **oral** exam. Grade at least 4 in each; ranking by the average (Ordinance No. 36).

cards.front: What must the notary office have?
cards.back: **Two or more functionally connected rooms** with the chancery and the archive; only one office in the district (Art. 13 ЗННД).

cards.front: Name four activities incompatible with the notary profession.
cards.back: MP, minister, mayor or councillor; state or municipal post; employment contract; practising as a lawyer; trade or management of companies (Art. 9 ЗННД).

quiz.question: A law graduate with legal capacity and no work experience wants to become an assistant notary. Is that possible?
options: Yes, the requirements for a notary apply regardless of age and experience
No, three years of experience are always needed
No, an assistant notary must be over 30
Only after the competition for notaries
quiz.explanation: Art. 41(1) waives age and experience for assistant notaries. Experience is needed only for substitution.

quiz.question: Which act may an assistant notary NOT perform, even on the instructions of the notary?
quiz.explanation: Mortgages are excluded by Art. 40(1), item 4.

quiz.question: What makes an assistant notary able to act alone while the notary is on holiday?
options: Entry as a substitute after three years of experience and an exam
A written power of attorney from the notary
Nothing; the assistant can always act alone
quiz.explanation: Substitution by an assistant notary requires the experience under Art. 8(1)(3) and an exam.

quiz.question: How long may one term of substitution by an assistant notary last?
quiz.explanation: The term may not exceed two years from the entry in the register.

quiz.question: What may candidates use at the exam for substitutes?
options: Legal acts and case law on paper
A laptop with a legal database
quiz.explanation: Only normative acts and case law on paper are allowed.

quiz.question: What is the minimum grade to pass the written exam of the competition for notaries and go to the oral exam?
quiz.explanation: Only candidates with at least good (4) go to the oral exam.

quiz.question: A district has 45,000 inhabitants. How many notary places does the general rule give?
quiz.explanation: One place for every 10,000 inhabitants: 45,000 gives four places, and never fewer than two.

quiz.question: For how many districts may a candidate apply in one competition?
quiz.explanation: The application lists up to three judicial districts in order of preference.

quiz.question: Which activity is compatible with the work of a notary?
options: Teaching law as a freelance lecturer without an employment contract
quiz.explanation: Art. 9 lists incompatible activities. Freelance teaching is not among them; an employment contract is.

quiz.question: What must a new notary have before entry in the register?
options: An office with two or more functionally connected rooms, insurance, a seal specimen and a signature specimen
A recommendation from the district court
quiz.explanation: Art. 13 and Art. 14(2) list the office, insurance, seal and signature requirements.

quiz.question: What secrecy duty does a newly hired clerk have?
options: None until the end of the probation period
quiz.explanation: Employees keep official secrecy under the same conditions as the notary.

quiz.question: Who trains the employees of a notary office?
options: The notary is obliged to introduce, train and guide them
quiz.explanation: Art. 34(2) puts this duty on the notary. The Council of Notaries also runs training.
